about:
Auto Customs was founded in 1986 in Honolulu, Hawaii, and operates as a locally-owned and operated business in the Waiakamilo business district. The company began as a single-location shop serving Oahu and the outer islands with automotive parts and installation services.

The company stocks and installs a wide range of aftermarket automotive products, including wheels, factory-replacement performance tires, suspension components, HID/LED lighting, brakes, window tint, exhaust systems, intakes, and body kits. Its 6,000-square-foot facility houses tire-balancing equipment and a team of installers who handle everything from custom wheel fitments to suspension modifications. The shop also maintains a comfortable lounge for customers waiting on service.

Auto Customs serves retail customers across Honolulu, Oahu, and the outer Hawaiian islands, catering to both stock-replacement needs (tire sizes from 13 to 32 inches) and highly modified builds ranging from lowered “hella-flush” cars to lifted four-wheel-drive trucks. The company’s inventory spans OEM and aftermarket brands from AEM to Zinik.

The business emphasizes a one-stop-shop approach, combining product availability with same-day installation capability, and highlights its knowledgeable staff and customer service as key differentiators in the local aftermarket scene.
